boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-cost group options centered on Westerville Public Library spaces and its current Culture Pass program.

cards.title: Plan a group session in Meeting Room A
cards.subtitle: Westerville Public Library · 126 S State St
cards.notes: Reserve this room for a study circle, club planning session, or project meeting; it has tables, chairs, internet, and a ceiling-mounted projector.
cards.short_summary: A reservable room for groups of 3–50 with presentation equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Westerville Public Library states that its eight rooms and meeting spaces may be reserved for free; Meeting Room A has capacity for 3–50 people and includes internet and a projector.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Room | Westerville Public Library
cards.access_notes: Reserve in advance; rooms are first come, first served and library doors do not open early.

cards.title: Set up a small-group hang in Meeting Room B
cards.subtitle: Westerville Public Library · 126 S State St
cards.notes: Book this smaller meeting room when your group wants a table-and-chair setup for conversation, planning, or collaborative study without buying anything.
cards.short_summary: A free reservable room sized for groups of 3–25.
cards.evidence_claim: Westerville Public Library states that its eight rooms and meeting spaces may be reserved for free; Meeting Room B has capacity for 3–25 people.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Room | Westerville Public Library
cards.access_notes: Reserve in advance; rooms are first come, first served and library doors do not open early.

cards.title: Gather a larger crew in A & B combined
cards.subtitle: Westerville Public Library · 126 S State St
cards.notes: Choose the combined setup for a larger club meeting, workshop-style study session, or presentation; arrange the supplied tables and chairs to fit the plan.
cards.short_summary: A free combined room option for groups of 40–100.
cards.evidence_claim: Westerville Public Library states that its eight rooms and meeting spaces may be reserved for free; the combined A & B room has capacity for 40–100 people, internet, and a projector.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Room | Westerville Public Library
cards.access_notes: Reserve in advance; the combined room has a 40-person minimum and is first come, first served.

cards.title: Share a screen in Meeting Room C
cards.subtitle: Westerville Public Library · 126 S State St
cards.notes: Reserve Room C for a compact co-working or viewing session; bring a device to use the room’s 60-inch display with HDMI audio or Apple AirPlay.
cards.short_summary: A free small meeting room with a 60-inch digital display.
cards.evidence_claim: Westerville Public Library states that its eight rooms and meeting spaces may be reserved for free; Meeting Room C holds 3–13 people and includes a 60-inch display with HDMI and Apple AirPlay.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Room | Westerville Public Library
cards.access_notes: Reserve in advance; rooms are first come, first served and library doors do not open early.

cards.title: Sketch ideas on Meeting Room D’s smartboard
cards.subtitle: Westerville Public Library · 126 S State St
cards.notes: Book Room D for a group brainstorm, presentation practice, or collaborative study session using the room’s internet-enabled smartboard and table setup.
cards.short_summary: A free 3–14-person room with a 75-inch smartboard.
cards.evidence_claim: Westerville Public Library states that its eight rooms and meeting spaces may be reserved for free; Meeting Room D holds 3–14 people and has a 75-inch internet-enabled smartboard.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Room | Westerville Public Library
cards.access_notes: Reserve in advance; rooms are first come, first served and library doors do not open early.

cards.title: Book a focused session in Pink or Purple
cards.subtitle: Westerville Public Library · 126 S State St
cards.notes: Reserve one of these study rooms for a small project team, interview practice, or quiet viewing session; each has a digital display for videoconferencing.
cards.short_summary: Free study rooms for up to seven people, with a three-hour limit.
cards.evidence_claim: Westerville Public Library states that its eight rooms and meeting spaces may be reserved for free; the Pink and Purple study rooms have digital displays and a three-hour daily reservation limit.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Room | Westerville Public Library
cards.access_notes: Present a photo ID or library card at the second-floor desk for study-room access; limit is three hours per day.

cards.title: Use a Culture Pass for a chorus performance
cards.subtitle: Culture Pass pickup at Westerville Public Library
cards.notes: Stop by the library’s second-floor desk and ask about the current pass before choosing a select chorus performance; confirm availability with the box office.
cards.short_summary: A library pass can cover one select performance for two people.
cards.evidence_claim: Westerville Public Library’s Culture Pass program offers free admission with a library card; its Columbus Gay Men’s Chorus pass covers one select performance for two people of any age.
cards.access_notes: Passes are released one month before performances, supplies may be limited, and redemption is for select performances only.

cards.title: Check out a Museum of Art Culture Pass
cards.subtitle: Culture Pass pickup at Westerville Public Library
cards.notes: Pick up the library’s pass at the second-floor desk, then plan a museum day with friends; the pass also includes special exhibitions, excluding special events.
cards.short_summary: A library pass provides one-day museum admission for a group.
cards.evidence_claim: Westerville Public Library’s Culture Pass page lists one-day free Columbus Museum of Art admission for up to two adults/seniors and four children under 18; it says availability is always available.
cards.access_notes: Requires a Culture Pass from the library; the pass covers admission, while listed parking is discounted rather than free.

cards.title: Borrow a pass for The Dawes Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Culture Pass pickup at Westerville Public Library
cards.notes: Get a pass at the library’s second-floor desk and use it for an outdoor day with up to five others; walk the trails and explore the plant collections.
cards.short_summary: A library pass covers one day of general admission for six people.
cards.evidence_claim: Westerville Public Library’s Culture Pass page lists one-day general admission to The Dawes Arboretum for six people and says the pass is always available.
cards.access_notes: Requires a Culture Pass from the library; the pass expires one month after receipt and excludes registered programs and events.

cards.title: Try for a Franklin Park Conservatory pass
cards.subtitle: Culture Pass pickup at Westerville Public Library
cards.notes: Check the second-floor desk when monthly passes are released, then coordinate a garden visit for your group before the pass’s seven-day validity window closes.
cards.short_summary: A library pass covers general admission for two adults and six children.
cards.evidence_claim: Westerville Public Library’s Culture Pass page lists Franklin Park Conservatory general admission for two adults and six children; passes are released monthly on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.access_notes: Requires a Culture Pass from the library; availability is monthly and first come, first served, and the pass is valid for seven days.
